name: Restoration Stewards Program

funder.name: Global Landscapes Forum and Youth in Landscapes Initiative

summary: One-year programme of funding, mentoring and visibility for young people leading restoration projects on the ground across forests, drylands, wetlands, peatlands, mountains and coasts.

applicant_types.quote: The program is open to young leaders, typically aged 18 to 35, who are actively involved in ecosystem restoration efforts within their communities.
